name: Calm Yourself
text: THIS UNIT HEALS 1 HP. YOU MAY REMOVE 1 EFFECT TOKEN FROM EACH ALLY UNIT.

name: Cosmic Boost
text: ALL UNACTIVATED ALLY UNITS GAIN +1 MAX ENERGY THIS ROUND.

name: Fight For Me
text: SELECT AN ALLY UNIT THAT WAS DOWNED THIS ROUND. RAISE IT TO 2 HP.

name: Fight On Friends!
text: ALL ALLY UNITS IN RANGE 5 OF THIS UNIT HEAL FOR 1 HP.

name: Forward
text: ALL ALLIES MAY MAKE A 2 MOVEMENT.

name: Go Forth My Minions
text: ALL CORRUPTED UNITS HEAL TO MAX HP. ALL CORRUPTED UNITS MAY MAKE A 2 MOVEMENT. IF THER ARE NO CORRUPTED UNITS ON THE BOARD, YOU MAY PLACE 1 CORRUPTED UNIT IN RANGE 2 OF THIS UNIT.

name: Immovable
text: THIS UNIT GAINS 1 SHIELD. SELECT AN ENEMY UNIT IN RANGE 3 OF THIS UNIT TO GAIN 1 STUNNED.

name: No One Escapes Me
text: AT THE END OF ACTIVATION, THIS UNIT MAY TAKE THE SNIPER SHOT ACTION FOR 0 ENERGY AGAINST A UNIT ALREADY TARGETED THIS TURN.

name: One With Shadows
text: THIS UNIT GAINS 1 STEALTH. THIS UNIT GAINS +3 MOVEMENT FOR THIS ACTIVATION.

name: Restore
text: HEAL UP TO 3 HP ON ALLY UNITS. (TOTAL NOT EACH)

name: Sabotage
text: REMOVE ALL ENERGY FROM 1 ENEMY UNIT OF YOUR CHOICE.

name: Suffer!
text: ENEMY UNITS IN RANGE 2 OF THIS UNIT GAIN 1 BLEED. ALL ENEMY UNITS WITH BLEED TAKE 1 DAMAGE.

name: White Out
text: ALL ENEMY UNITS IN RANGE 4 OF THIS UNIT GAIN 1 SLOW. YOU MAY PLACE AN ICE WALL IN RANGE 3 OF THIS UNIT.
